card.title: KŌFU REGIMENT
card.text: Destruction: Deal 1 damage to the enemy HQ, give yours +1 defense.
card.flavorText: The Kōfu Regiment was part of the 201st Division, one of the final infantry divisions raised by the Imperial Japanese Army in 1945. Known as the Musashi Division, it was organized as a triangular division and stationed in the Kantō region of Honshu as part of the 36th Army. Its creation was a direct response to the US landings on Okinawa and to Japan's growing fear of an Allied invasion of the home islands. The division’s 501st Infantry Regiment was based in Zama, while the 502nd and 503rd Regiments were stationed in Musashimurayama, close to Tokyo. Other units deployed near Gotemba, forming a second defensive perimeter around the capital. The division’s task was to reinforce inland defenses against an anticipated amphibious assault, if the Allied launched Operation Downfall. Although fully mobilized, the 201st Division never engaged in combat. Japan surrendered before Allied forces landed on the main islands, leaving the division’s soldiers, including those of the Kōfu Regiment, untested in battle. Nevertheless, their deployment reflected Japan’s urgent shift to homeland defense during the final months of the war.
